how_to_edit: Each block is one section of the What We Offer page, in order. image is a photo name from the images folder (without -sm or -lg), or null for a placeholder. button_link can be #signup or a web address (for example a gear store).

offerings.title: Parent Meetups
offerings.headline: Tailgates on the bank and dinners on race weekends
offerings.text: Pop-up tents along the Charles, a blanket on the grass at Redwood Shores, a table for twelve after the final. We find the spot and save you a seat.
offerings.alt: The family celebrating on the shore after a race

offerings.title: Newsletters
offerings.headline: Results, photos and what's next
offerings.text: A friendly roundup after every race weekend: how the boats did, the best photos, and the dates to put on the fridge.
offerings.alt: Parker at the dock with his medal after a race

offerings.title: Announcements
offerings.headline: Race day news, fast
offerings.text: Start times move. Lineups change. Weather happens. Get a quick heads-up so you're on the bridge at the right moment.
offerings.alt: Spectators on a bridge watching a Tufts eight pass below

offerings.title: Gear
offerings.headline: Cheer in style
offerings.text: Stadium blankets, knit hats and team colors for the cold mornings of fall racing. The first gear drop is in the works.
offerings.button_text: Hear about the first gear drop

offerings.title: Events
offerings.headline: Head of the Charles weekend and more
offerings.text: Our signature weekend each October on the Charles, plus watch parties for the big championships out west.
offerings.alt: An eight racing on the Charles River with fall foliage
